summary: Mountain bicyclist fell and was injured in the Sugar Bowl area just west of Buttermilk Mountain; MRA deployed into the field and CareFlight transported the patient to Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: Sugar Bowl area, just west of Buttermilk Mountain
notes: Riding partner present; MRA field contact ~7 PM, CareFlight contact ~8:06 PM. Pitkin County Sheriff's Office, CareFlight of the Rockies also involved.
